data_quality.Source: ESPN final scoreboard/box scores or official NBA LiveData where accessible; all 10 FINAL fixtures and player-point totals reconciled; {'ESPN_final_fixtures': 10, 'NBA_game_id_crosscheck': 'All 10 NBA Cup game IDs checked against NBA.com and ESPN final fixtures'}
data_quality.Basketball-Reference: Date index fetched, but individual basic and advanced box-score tables were not independently reconciled; primary per-player source is NBA LiveData or ESPN: https://www.basketball-reference.com/boxscores/?month=10&day=30&year=2026

data_quality.C6 second-chance points: 0/230 individual records available; rest omitted (engine zero fallback)
data_quality.C6 fast-break points: 0/230 individual records available; rest omitted (engine zero fallback)
data_quality.C6 paint points: 0/230 individual records available; rest omitted (engine zero fallback)
data_quality.C11 fast-break bonus: Individual fast-break values available for 0/230 records; omitted where absent
data_quality.QPIX-R: Authorized generate-report.js seasonal/positional FTA baselines; no fabricated rolling-20 FTA
data_quality.QPIX-SFA: Authorized checked-in former_team_familiarity.json, requiring verified individual ratings to trigger; no score-substitutes
data_quality.game-point reconciliation: PASS: All team individual player points exactly match official final scores
data_quality.Player inclusion: All recorded ESPN or NBA LiveData players with >0 minutes; no 5-minute cutoff
data_quality.Top 10 eligibility: More than 8 minutes played; zero minimum field-goal attempts. All player results remain in JSON/CSV.
